test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT pair related to digestive glands and their enzymes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salivary gland — trypsin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salivary glands** secrete **saliva**, which contains the enzyme **amylase** (also known as ptyalin), not **trypsin**.
 
• **Trypsin** is an enzyme produced in the **pancreas** and released into the small intestine. It helps in digesting proteins.
 
• The main enzymes secreted by the **salivary glands** are **amylase**, which begins the digestion of carbohydrates in the mouth.
 
• **Amylase** breaks down starches into simpler sugars like maltose and dextrin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Liver — bile juice**__

 __
 
• The **liver** produces **bile juice**, which is stored in the gallbladder.
 
• **Bile** contains bile salts that help in the emulsification of fats, making them easier to digest.
 
• **Bile** also aids in the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins such as A, D, E, and K.
 
 
 
• **Gastric gland — pepsin**__
 __
 
• **Gastric glands** in the stomach lining secrete **pepsinogen**, which is converted to **pepsin** in the presence of hydrochloric acid (HCl).
 
• **Pepsin** is a proteolytic enzyme that breaks down proteins into peptides.
 
• The acidic environment in the stomach is essential for the activation and function of **pepsin**.
 
 
 
• **Pancreas — pancreatic juice**__
 
 
• The **pancreas** secretes **pancreatic juice**, which contains several digestive enzymes.
 
• These enzymes include **trypsin**, **chymotrypsin**, **amylase**, and **lipase**.
 
• **Pancreatic juice** also contains bicarbonate ions that neutralize the acidic chyme entering the small intestine from the stomach.
